# ADR-NNN: Decision title

Date: YYYY-MM-DD · Status: proposed/accepted/superseded · Owner: name/team

## Context and evidence

State the user-visible requirement, constraints, measured load, sensitive data and unknowns. Link the relevant code or incident.

## Options

Compare at least two viable approaches on complexity, reliability, security, cost and reversibility.

## Decision

Describe the chosen boundary and request/data flow. Include failure behavior and explicit assumptions.

## Consequences and validation

List benefits, costs, migration/rollback, acceptance tests, operational owner and review trigger. Distinguish implemented behavior from planned work.
